notes.subject: שאון
notes.rationale: 'Uproar/rushing' — KJV 'horrible' pit (from LXX), JPS 'tumultuous' pit; rendered here as pit of loud noise.

notes.subject: אשורי
notes.rationale: Rare word: 'my steps' vs some read 'my path/going'; here 'steps of my walking'.

notes.subject: matmat bilong graun wara
notes.rationale: מטיט היון 'mire of dregs/mud' — two near-synonymous mud words, split into Tok Pisin 'mud of watery ground'.

translation: Na em i bringim mi antap long hul bilong bikpela noiz, long matmat bilong graun wara, na em i sanapim ol leg bilong mi antap long ston, em i strongim ol hap bilong wokabaut bilong mi.

ol hap bilong wokabaut bilong mi
